Definition
[piecewise parallel transport] 1. ch3:3.1↗ def:dc-ch3-3-1

Parallel transport along a piecewise differentiable curve is obtained by transporting a single own-foot field in succession on each differentiable segment of a finite partition, with the values agreeing at every vertex. The endpoint transport is the relation between the initial and terminal values of such a field.
